第33章 吃醋的刘施施-《华娱2008：从分手快乐开始》

快步跟上去，两人来到一家“韩式服装”店。

这地方位于七浦路，七浦谐音“cheap”，意味着便宜廉价的一条街。

七浦路在千禧年的时候非常火，现在依旧热闹，聚集了大量韩版连衣裙和配饰。

刘施施逛的非常开心。

这女人扑到衣服上，就像饥饿的人扑到面包上，两条腿跟跟灌了铅似的，挪不动道。

服装店的老板是一位三十岁左右的时尚女人，梳着时下流行的BOB头，姿色中上，眉宇间透着一股媚态。

店里来客人，她赶忙上去招呼。

“美女，想要点什么？”

面对琳琅满目的衣服，刘施施眼睛迸发出神采，像只穿梭在花丛中的蝴蝶，一时之间挑花了眼。

与此同时，老板娘也在打量着对方。

这女孩瞅着年龄不大，也就二十岁出头，最是好忽悠的时候。

“我这里全是韩国那边流行的衣服款式，你看看这面料这质感....”

正当她夸夸其谈的时候，手里提着两个袋子的大帅哥慢慢走过来。

刘施施回头，眼含笑意的冲他招了招小手。

“魏沐，你快帮我看看，哪个好看。”

“呦。这是你男朋友吧，长得真帅，跟明星似的。”

老板娘眼睛一亮，迈开黑丝长腿凑了过去。

她在七浦路开店多年，见过形形色色不少人，这位最是好看。

被老板娘打岔，刘施施耳根有些发热。

她刚想说话，却听身边的男人赶紧解释：“老板你误会了，我们不是男女朋友。”

听闻此言，刘施施一直在挑衣服的手突然顿了一下，然后慢慢缩回去。

啧啧，不是对象，刚才还叫的这么亲切。

老板娘是见过吃过的主，没有多说，只是看魏沐的眼神明显多了一丝热切。

魏沐对这种眼神非常熟悉，他上辈子没少遇到过这些眼神，大部分来自女人，少部分来自男人。

“嗐，是我眼拙。帅哥想买点什么？我们这边也有男装。”

一边说，她一边从货架上拿起一件战损版牛仔裤。

“这是韩国最流行的款式，你要不要试试？”

魏沐打量着牛仔裤，在他眼里就是一件普通牛仔裤。

其实他一直不能理解好好的牛仔裤，为什么非要在上面弄几个破洞。

见魏沐没有说话，老板娘又去翻找其他衣服。

明显感觉到受冷落的施施同学不开心，她噘着嘴指向手边的一件连衣裙。

“老板，我要这件，你给我打包一下。”

Following quickly, the two came to a "Korean clothing" store.

This place is located on Qipu Road. Qipu is homophonic to "cheap", which means a cheap street.

Chilpo Road was very popular during the millennium, and it is still lively now, with a large number of Korean-style dresses and accessories.

Liu Shishi was very happy shopping.

The woman threw herself on the clothes, like a hungry person throwing herself on bread, her legs felt like lead, unable to move.

The owner of the clothing store is a fashionable woman in her thirties. She wears the popular BOB haircut. She has an upper-middle look and a charming look between her eyebrows.

When a customer came to the store, she hurried up to greet him.

"Beauty, what do you want?"

Facing the dazzling array of clothes, Liu Shishi's eyes sparkled, like a butterfly flying through the flowers, and she was dazzled for a moment.

At the same time, the landlady was also looking at the other party.

This girl looks young, only in her early twenties, which is when she is most likely to be fooled.

"What I have here are all the popular clothing styles in Korea. Look at the texture of the fabric..."

Just as she was bragging, a handsome guy slowly walked over with two bags in his hands.

Liu Shishi turned around and waved to him with a smile in his eyes.

"Wei Mu, please help me see which one looks better."

"Hey. This is your boyfriend, he looks so handsome, like a star."

The landlady's eyes lit up, and she stepped forward with her long black stocking legs.

She has opened a shop on Qipu Road for many years and has seen many people of all kinds. This one is the most beautiful.

Interrupted by the landlady, Liu Shishi felt a little hot.

She was about to speak, but the man beside her quickly explained: "Boss, you have misunderstood, we are not boyfriend and girlfriend."

After hearing this, Liu Shishi's hand that had been picking out clothes suddenly paused, and then slowly retracted it.

Tsk tsk, that’s not the right person. You were calling her so kindly just now.

The landlady had seen the owner before and didn't say much. She just looked at Wei Mu with a visibly more eager look.

Wei Mu was very familiar with this kind of look. He had encountered these looks many times in his previous life, mostly from women and a few from men.

"Hey, it's just my poor eyesight. What do you want to buy, handsome guy? We also have men's clothing here."

As she spoke, she picked up a pair of war-damaged jeans from the shelf.

"This is the most popular style in Korea. Do you want to try it?"

Wei Mu looked at the jeans. In his eyes, they were just ordinary jeans.

In fact, he has never understood why good jeans have to have a few holes in them.

Seeing that Wei Mu didn't say anything, the landlady went to look for other clothes.

Shi Shi, who clearly felt that she was being left out, was unhappy. She pouted and pointed to a dress at hand.

"Boss, I want this, please pack it for me."
